label: Gresset 2002
setting: community (home interview; Canadian Study of Health and Aging, Montreal-area subsample for examination)
recruitment: random community sample of Quebec residents aged 65+ drawn around 4 CSHA centres, 1991-1992, ages 75+ oversampled; 98.7% of eligible completed questionnaire. Validation: Montreal-area subjects not eligible for other CSHA components; all screen-positive plus random sample of screen-negative invited; 144 eligible, 31 lost, 42 refused, 6 not scheduled, 65 examined (participation 45.1%)
cohort: CSHA Quebec community sample (1800 sampled; 1777 completed)
notes: pct_female = 1106/1777 (p3), not stated as a percentage. Examination n=65: 19 with >=1 positive response, 46 with two negative responses (p3). Examiner (JG) masked to responses. Sampling fraction differed by screen result so sens/spec cannot be applied to an unselected population (p3). Visual examination at home: ETDRS distance VA at 4 m, near VA at 0.4 m, visual fields, refraction. Best-corrected-VA results not tabulated because only 2 subjects changed category after refraction (p3). Prevalence/utilization study with a validation substage.
